cues: Behind the root cap, cells divide in the zone of cell division.
Behind that, in the zone of elongation, they stretch.
Further back, in the zone of maturation, they take on their final form.
text: Look at a root tip. Behind the root cap, cells divide in the zone of cell division. Behind that, in the zone of elongation, they stretch. Further back, in the zone of maturation, they take on their final form.
